notes.title: Choose your nightmare – difficulty levels in Shadowless
notes.content:
[h1]🩸 Choose your nightmare 🩸[/h1][p]In [b]Shadowless[/b], you won't just be walking through darkness—you'll decide how deep you want to go.
You can now choose from three unique difficulty levels:[/p][list][*][p]👶 [b]Mom, hold my hand[/b]
For those who want to experience the story and explore the world of Shadowless without major obstacles.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]😶 [b]Things get worse[/b]
Recommended choice. Horror that gradually escalates and reality that cracks under pressure.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]💀 [b]Darkness f***s you[/b]
Your mind will be tested to the brink of insanity. Only for the brave who are not afraid of the last light going out.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whichever path you choose, [b]darkness will follow you.[/b]
The question is: [i][b]will you survive it?[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Shadowless is coming to Steam!
notes.content: [p]Hi, everybody![/p][p][/p][p]The day has finally come! I am incredibly excited and proud to announce that the official Shadowless Steam page is now live! This is a huge milestone and the result of countless hours of hard work. This is not just a site for us, it's the first open door into the world we're building.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that the site is up and running, I have one very important request. If you like Shadowless, please take a moment of your time and add it to your Steam wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774430" style="button"]Add Shadowless to your wishlist![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Why is this so important? Every time I add Shadowless to my wishlist, it helps me immensely. It tells Steam's algorithm that you're interested in the game, which greatly increases its visibility. It's really the most effective way you can support the game right now.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning. I've got a long way to go, but I can't wait to share more about the development and story of Shadowless with you all.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely, ultron01[/p]
